items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: I played drum with Fat Pichon when we were young kids. When he first started his little band up, I played drum with him

ctx.x: You never wanted to take up music? Did you ever play any of that? Yeah I played music.

Oh you did? I played drum. You didn't play drums? But not too long. I played drum with Fat Pichon when we were young kids. When he first started his little band up, I played drum with him, several little house parties. But I never did like music. And my oldest brother, he was teaching me clarinet, the one that got killed. Oh yeah. And I took that up for a while, then I gave that up. I didn't like, I just didn't go for music.
Did your father ever help you with drums or did you start after that?
